t: Cognitive Architecture: A Shared Mental Model for Human-AI Development
s: This article proposes a 'DOM Schema Visualizer' as a shared cognitive architecture to prevent AI 'infinite regression' bugs by providing a structured, prioritized representation of web page DOMs for human-AI collaboration.
sub: Preventing AI infinite regression with structured data
DOM Schema Visualizer as a shared cognitive architecture
Philosophical underpinnings of structure from complexity (Anaximander, Democritus)
